recipes.name: Plăcintă cu Brânză Sărată (Salty Cheese Pie)
recipes.description: Flaky phyllo layers filled with crumbled telemea, fresh cheese and dill, baked until golden and cut into squares.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and brush a rectangular baking tray with melted butter.
Crumble the telemea into a bowl, mix in the cottage cheese, eggs, sour cream and chopped dill, and season with pepper.
Lay half of the phyllo sheets in the tray, brushing every second sheet with melted butter.
Spread the cheese filling evenly over the pastry, then cover with the remaining sheets, brushing each with butter.
Score the top into squares, brush with the last of the butter and bake for 35 to 40 minutes until deep golden.
Let the pie rest for 10 minutes before cutting along the scored lines and serving warm or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Pateuri cu Brânză (Puff Pastry Cheese Pockets)
recipes.description: Golden puff pastry triangles stuffed with salty telemea and dill, the classic Romanian bakery snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Mash the telemea with a fork, mix in the cottage cheese, one egg and the chopped dill.
Roll out the puff pastry and cut it into 10 cm squares.
Place a spoonful of filling in the centre of each square, fold into a triangle and press the edges with a fork to seal.
Beat the second egg and brush it over the pastries, then sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden; serve warm.

recipes.name: Saleuri (Romanian Cheese Sticks)
recipes.description: Crumbly, buttery cheese sticks with caraway seeds, the salty biscuit no Romanian party table is without.
instructions: Rub the cold cubed butter into the flour with the salt until it resembles coarse breadcrumbs.
Add the grated cascaval, sour cream and one egg yolk and knead briefly into a smooth dough; chill for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 180°C and line two trays with baking paper.
Roll the dough to 5 mm thickness and cut into 1 cm wide strips about 8 cm long.
Brush with the beaten remaining egg and sprinkle with caraway seeds and a little coarse salt.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until lightly golden and cool completely before serving.

recipes.name: Covrigei cu Sare (Salted Pretzel Rings)
recipes.description: Chewy little bread rings with a glossy crust and a crunchy coat of coarse salt, perfect for dipping.
instructions: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in the warm water and let it foam for 5 minutes.
Mix in the flour, salt and oil and knead for 8 minutes into a smooth, elastic dough; cover and rise for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into 16 pieces, roll each into a 20 cm rope and pinch the ends together to form rings.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil with the baking soda and boil the rings for 30 seconds on each side.
Drain, place on a lined tray, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle generously with coarse salt.
Bake at 220°C for 15 to 18 minutes until deep golden brown.

ingredients.note: 1 tsp for dough, coarse salt for topping

recipes.name: Chifteluțe de Post (Vegan Vegetable Patties)
recipes.description: Crisp golden patties of grated potato, carrot and mushroom with dill and garlic, fried until crunchy.
instructions: Peel and coarsely grate the potatoes and carrots, then squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Finely chop the onion and mushrooms and sauté them in a little oil until the moisture evaporates.
Combine the vegetables with the crushed garlic, chopped dill, breadcrumbs and flour; season well with salt and pepper.
Shape the mixture with wet hands into small flat patties.
Fry in hot sunflower oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side until deep golden and crisp.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with mustard or a garlic sauce.

recipes.name: Bulz (Polenta Balls with Cheese)
recipes.description: Shepherd-style polenta balls hiding a molten telemea centre, baked with butter and served with sour cream.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil with the salt, pour in the cornmeal in a thin stream while whisking, and cook for 25 minutes, stirring often.
Let the polenta cool until you can handle it, then grease your hands with a little butter.
Take a handful of polenta, flatten it, place a cube of telemea and a little chopped smoked bacon in the centre and close into a ball.
Arrange the balls in a buttered oven dish and dot with the remaining butter.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until the surface is golden and the cheese has melted.
Serve hot with a spoonful of sour cream on top.

recipes.name: Ouă Umplute (Romanian Deviled Eggs)
recipes.description: Hard-boiled egg halves piped with a creamy mustard-mayo yolk filling, dusted with sweet paprika.
instructions: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool them in cold water and peel.
Halve the eggs lengthwise and pop the yolks into a bowl.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, finely chopped pickle and parsley; season with salt and pepper.
Spoon or pipe the filling back into the egg whites.
Dust with sweet paprika, chill for 20 minutes and serve on a platter.

recipes.name: Roșii Umplute cu Salată de Vinete (Tomatoes Stuffed with Eggplant Spread)
recipes.description: Juicy summer tomatoes hollowed out and filled with creamy roasted eggplant spread, topped with olives.
instructions: Cut a lid off each tomato and scoop out the seeds and pulp with a teaspoon; sprinkle the insides with salt and turn upside down for 10 minutes.
Mix the eggplant spread with the finely chopped red onion and half of the parsley.
Fill the tomatoes generously with the eggplant mixture.
Top each with an olive, a drizzle of olive oil and the remaining parsley.
Chill for 15 minutes and serve on a bed of lettuce leaves.

recipes.name: Cașcaval Pane (Breaded Fried Cheese)
recipes.description: Thick slices of cascaval in a crunchy paprika breadcrumb coat, fried until the centre oozes.
instructions: Cut the cascaval into 1.5 cm thick slices.
Set up three plates: flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs mixed with paprika and pepper.
Coat each slice in flour, dip in egg, then press into the breadcrumbs; repeat the egg and breadcrumb layer for a tight seal.
Heat 1 cm of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the slices for about 1 minute per side until golden, working quickly so the cheese does not leak.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Zacuscă on Toast
recipes.description: Toasted rye bread spread thick with smoky roasted pepper and eggplant zacuscă, finished with red onion rings.
instructions: Toast the rye bread slices until crisp on both sides.
Rub each warm slice lightly with the cut side of the garlic clove and drizzle with olive oil.
Spread a generous layer of zacuscă on every slice.
Top with thin red onion rings, chopped parsley and a grind of black pepper.
Cut in halves and serve at room temperature.

recipes.name: Langoși (Fried Dough with Cheese and Garlic)
recipes.description: Puffy fried yeast dough discs rubbed with garlic and piled with sour cream and crumbled telemea.
instructions: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in the warm milk and let it foam for 5 minutes.
Add the flour and salt and knead into a soft dough; cover and let it rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Divide into 8 balls and stretch each into a thin 15 cm disc with your hands.
Heat 2 cm of oil in a deep pan and fry the discs for 1 to 2 minutes per side until puffed and golden.
Drain on paper towels, then rub each hot langoș with a cut garlic clove.
Spread with sour cream, scatter crumbled telemea over the top and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Classic Tomato Bruschetta
recipes.description: Garlic-rubbed toasted baguette topped with ripe diced tomatoes, torn basil and good olive oil.
instructions: Dice the tomatoes, discarding most of the seeds, and mix with torn basil, 2 tablespoons of olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt and pepper; let stand 10 minutes.
Slice the baguette diagonally into 2 cm slices and brush with the remaining olive oil.
Toast the slices under a hot grill or in a pan until golden on both sides.
Rub each warm slice with the cut garlic clove.
Spoon the tomato mixture onto the toasts just before serving so they stay crisp.

recipes.name: Garlic Knots
recipes.description: Soft pizza-dough knots brushed with garlic butter and showered with parmesan and parsley.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper.
Roll the pizza dough into a rectangle and cut it into 12 strips about 2 cm wide.
Tie each strip loosely into a knot and arrange on the tray; let rest for 15 minutes.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until golden.
Meanwhile melt the butter with the crushed garlic and a pinch of salt over low heat for 2 minutes.
Brush the hot knots with the garlic butter and toss with grated parmesan and chopped parsley; serve with tomato sauce for dipping.

recipes.name: Cream Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms
recipes.description: Brown mushroom caps filled with garlicky herbed cream cheese and a crunchy parmesan crumb, baked until bubbling.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Wipe the mushrooms, remove the stems and chop the stems finely.
Sauté the chopped stems and garlic in 1 tablespoon of olive oil for 3 minutes until soft.
Mix the cooked stems with the cream cheese, half the parmesan, half the breadcrumbs and the chopped parsley; season with salt and pepper.
Fill each mushroom cap with the mixture and place in an oiled baking dish.
Top with the remaining breadcrumbs and parmesan and drizzle with the rest of the olive oil.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes until the mushrooms are tender and the tops are golden.

recipes.name: Crispy Mozzarella Sticks
recipes.description: Double-breaded mozzarella batons fried until crunchy outside and stretchy inside, served with warm marinara.
instructions: Cut the mozzarella into 1.5 cm thick batons and pat them dry.
Mix the breadcrumbs with oregano, garlic powder and a pinch of salt.
Coat each stick in flour, dip in beaten egg, then roll in breadcrumbs; repeat the egg and crumb layers once more.
Freeze the coated sticks for at least 30 minutes so they hold their shape.
Heat 3 cm of oil to 180°C and fry the sticks in batches for about 1 minute until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve right away with warm tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Loaded Nachos
recipes.description: A tray of tortilla chips buried under melted cheese, black beans, jalapeños and tomato, finished with sour cream.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and spread the tortilla chips over a large baking tray.
Scatter the drained beans and half the grated cheese over the chips.
Top with the diced tomato, sliced chili pepper and the remaining cheese.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese is fully melted and bubbling.
Finish with sliced green onions, chopped coriander and spoonfuls of sour cream; serve straight from the tray.

recipes.name: Chicken Quesadilla Bites
recipes.description: Crisp golden tortilla wedges packed with spiced chicken, peppers and melted cheese, cut into bite-size triangles.
instructions: Dice the chicken breast and bell pepper and fry in 1 tablespoon of oil with the cumin and a pinch of salt for 6 to 7 minutes until cooked.
Stir in the sliced green onions and remove from the heat.
Lay a tortilla in a dry pan, cover half with grated cheese, then the chicken mixture, then more cheese, and fold over.
Cook over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese has melted; repeat with the remaining tortillas.
Let rest for 1 minute, cut each quesadilla into 4 wedges and serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Baked Vegetable Spring Rolls
recipes.description: Crisp oven-baked phyllo rolls filled with ginger-soy cabbage, carrot and bean sprouts, no deep frying needed.
instructions: Shred the cabbage and carrots finely and slice the green onions.
Stir-fry the vegetables with the grated ginger in 1 tablespoon of oil for 3 minutes, add the bean sprouts, soy sauce and sesame oil, cook 1 minute more and cool.
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Cut the phyllo sheets in half, brush each with oil and stack two halves.
Place 2 tablespoons of filling near one edge, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Arrange seam-side down on a lined tray and brush the tops with oil.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp; serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Wings
recipes.description: Oven-crisped wings tossed in a tangy, buttery hot sauce glaze and served with cool celery sticks.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C and set a rack over a lined baking tray.
Pat the wings completely dry and toss with the baking powder, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Spread the wings on the rack in a single layer and bake for 40 to 45 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.
Melt the butter and whisk in the hot sauce to make the buffalo glaze.
Toss the hot wings in the sauce until coated.
Serve immediately with celery sticks on the side.

recipes.name: Loaded Potato Skins
recipes.description: Twice-baked crispy potato boats filled with melted cheddar and crumbled bacon, topped with sour cream and chives.
instructions: Bake the whole potatoes at 200°C for 50 minutes until tender, then cool slightly.
Fry the bacon until crisp, drain and crumble.
Halve the potatoes and scoop out most of the flesh, leaving a 1 cm shell.
Brush the shells inside and out with melted butter, season with salt and pepper and bake for 10 minutes until crisp.
Fill with grated cheese and bacon and return to the oven for 5 minutes until melted.
Top with sour cream and sliced green onions and serve hot.

recipes.name: Mini Ham and Cheese Quiches
recipes.description: Bite-size shortcrust tartlets filled with silky egg custard, diced ham, Emmental and chives.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C and grease a 12-hole muffin tin.
Roll out the pastry, cut 10 cm circles and press them into the muffin holes.
Whisk the eggs with the cream, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Divide the diced ham, grated Emmental and chopped chives between the pastry cases.
Pour the egg mixture over the filling until each case is nearly full.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the filling is set and golden; cool for 5 minutes before removing.

recipes.name: Sausage Rolls
recipes.description: Flaky golden puff pastry wrapped around seasoned sausage meat with onion, thyme and a hint of mustard.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper.
Squeeze the sausage meat out of the casings and mix it with the finely chopped onion, thyme, mustard and pepper.
Cut the puff pastry into two long strips and shape half the meat into a log down the centre of each.
Brush one edge with beaten egg, fold the pastry over the meat and press to seal; cut each log into 6 pieces.
Place seam-side down on the tray, brush with egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until puffed, golden and cooked through.

recipes.name: Parmesan Herb Popcorn
recipes.description: Freshly popped corn tossed in melted butter, grated parmesan, rosemary and garlic for a savoury movie-night snack.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large lidded pot over medium-high heat with 3 kernels inside.
When the test kernels pop, add the rest of the popcorn, cover and shake the pot occasionally until the popping slows to a few seconds apart.
Melt the butter in a small pan with the crushed rosemary and garlic powder.
Pour the popcorn into a large bowl, drizzle with the herb butter and toss well.
Sprinkle with the grated parmesan and salt, toss again and serve warm.

recipes.name: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas
recipes.description: Crunchy oven-roasted chickpeas dusted with smoked paprika, cumin and garlic, a healthy swap for chips.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Drain and rinse the chickpeas and dry them very well on a kitchen towel.
Toss the chickpeas with the olive oil and spread on a lined baking tray in a single layer.
Roast for 25 minutes, shaking the tray halfway through.
Mix the smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder and salt and sprinkle over the hot chickpeas; toss to coat.
Return to the oven for 5 more minutes, then cool on the tray so they crisp up fully.

recipes.name: Crispy Kale Chips
recipes.description: Paper-thin kale leaves baked with olive oil, lemon and sea salt until they shatter like chips.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150°C and line two trays with baking paper.
Strip the kale leaves from the tough stems, tear into chip-size pieces, wash and dry thoroughly.
Massage the leaves with the olive oil, lemon juice and garlic powder until lightly coated.
Spread in a single layer without overlapping and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, rotating the trays once, until crisp but still green; cool for 3 minutes before eating.

recipes.name: Caprese Skewers
recipes.description: Cherry tomatoes, mini mozzarella balls and basil leaves threaded on picks and drizzled with balsamic glaze.
instructions: Drain the mozzarella balls and pat them dry.
Thread a cherry tomato, a folded basil leaf and a mozzarella ball onto each cocktail stick or short skewer.
Arrange the skewers on a serving platter.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze and season with flaky salt and pepper just before serving.

recipes.name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Melon
recipes.description: Sweet ripe melon wedges wrapped in salty prosciutto with fresh mint and a crack of black pepper.
instructions: Halve the melon, scoop out the seeds and cut the flesh into 12 wedges, trimming off the rind.
Wrap each wedge with a slice of prosciutto, leaving the ends of the melon showing.
Arrange on a platter and tuck a mint leaf into each wrap.
Finish with a drizzle of balsamic glaze and freshly ground black pepper; serve chilled.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Blinis
recipes.description: Fluffy little homemade pancakes topped with dill sour cream, folds of smoked salmon and lemon zest.
instructions: Whisk the flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt, then beat in the egg and milk to make a thick, smooth batter.
Heat a little butter in a non-stick pan and drop in teaspoons of batter to make 5 cm blinis.
Cook for 1 minute until bubbles appear, flip and cook 30 seconds more; repeat with the remaining batter and cool.
Mix the sour cream with half the chopped dill and the lemon zest.
Top each blini with a dollop of dill cream, a fold of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and black pepper and serve within the hour.

recipes.name: Arancini (Fried Risotto Balls)
recipes.description: Golden breadcrumbed balls of parmesan risotto with a molten mozzarella heart, a Sicilian street-food classic.
instructions: Sauté the finely chopped onion in olive oil until soft, add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add the hot broth a ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed, for about 18 minutes until the rice is tender; stir in the parmesan and one egg, season, spread on a tray and chill for 1 hour.
With wet hands shape the cold risotto into golf-ball-size balls, pressing a cube of mozzarella into the centre of each and closing it over.
Roll the balls in flour, then the remaining beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Heat 4 cm of oil to 175°C and fry the arancini in batches for 3 to 4 minutes until deep golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with warm tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Cucumber Tea Sandwiches
recipes.description: Dainty crustless sandwiches of thin cucumber on herbed cream cheese, cool and crisp for an afternoon spread.
instructions: Slice the cucumber paper-thin, sprinkle lightly with salt and let drain on paper towels for 10 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese with the softened butter, chopped dill and chives until smooth.
Spread the mixture on all the bread slices right to the edges.
Layer the cucumber slices over half of the bread, season with pepper and close with the remaining slices.
Trim off the crusts and cut each sandwich into 4 fingers or triangles; serve immediately or cover with a damp cloth until needed.
